test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT about the rivers of India?

options.text: The Krishna River rises near Mahabaleshwar in Sahyadri.
The Kaveri rises in Brahmagiri hills of Kogadu district in Karnataka.
The Mahanadi rises near Sihawa in Raipur district of Chhattisgarh.
The Godavari rises in the Jabalpur district of Madhya Pradesh.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Godavari rises in the Jabalpur district of Madhya Pradesh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Godavari River** actually rises from **Trimbak** near **Nashik** in the state of **Maharashtra**, not Jabalpur in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is the second-longest river in India, often referred to as the "Dakshina Ganga."
 
• The Godavari River has one of the largest drainage basins in India, covering parts of **Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Odisha**.
 
• It **plays a vital role in irrigation, water supply, and agriculture in these regions.**
 
• Major tributaries of the Godavari include the **Manjira, Pranhita, Indravati, Sabari, and Purna Rivers**, which contribute significantly to its flow and make it a lifeline for the Deccan Plateau.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Krishna River**

 
 
• The** Krishna River is the fourth-longest river in Indi**a, stretching approximately 1,400 km.
 
• It f**lows through Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh before emptying into the Bay of Bengal**.
 
• **Major Tributaries:** Important tributaries include the Tungabhadra, Bhima, Ghataprabha, Malaprabha, and Musi Rivers.
 
 
 
• **Kaveri River**
 
 
• The Kaveri is often referred to as the Ganga of the South due to its religious importance in South India.
 
• **The river forms a fertile delta in Tamil Nadu, s**upporting agriculture and earning the region the nickname "Rice Bowl of Tamil Nadu."
 
 
 
• **Mahanadi Rive**r
 
 
• **With a length of approximately 858 km**, the Mahanadi is a major river in East-Central India, primarily flowing through Chhattisgarh and Odisha.
 
• The **river is home to the Hirakud Dam, one of the longest dams in the world, which provides irrigation, hydroelectric power, and flood control.**
